turns.prompt_text: in Ames Iowa there's an airport is it possible I could learn how to fly there
turns.response_html:
Yes, you can learn to fly at the Ames Municipal Airport (AMW). There are two primary flight schools located on-field:

  • Central Iowa Air Service (CIAS): An FAA Part 141 certified school that offers structured training from Private Pilot through Commercial ratings.
  • Hap’s Air Service: A long-standing family-owned operation that provides one-on-one instruction, specifically utilizing Cessna 172 aircraft.

If you want to test the waters, both services typically offer discovery flights—short, introductory lessons where you can briefly take the controls with an instructor. Since you are at Iowa State, you might also check out the Flying Cyclones student club, which often has discounted training agreements with these providers.
